title: rosa viscaria var. ladanifera
intro: Rosa viscaria var. ladanifera, commonly known as Labdanum or Rockrose, is a shrub-like plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is native to the Mediterranean region and has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Rosa viscaria var. ladanifera include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which have been shown to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include labdanic acid, labdanolic acid, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting sedative and antispasmodic effects.
